title: os.json
description: What a site runs: the engine, the brand file's version, and each installed app. Every full build writes it, and the site's Worker sends it to the fleet service once per deployment. cms/generator/os-json.js is the authority (it also checks that apps and packages are both lists or both null); this file is the same shape for editors and other tools. Fields it doesn't name are allowed, so a newer engine can add one without an older service refusing it.

engine.description: The engine's version: the package the site installs.

slug.description: brand.json's slug. A site must have one to report.

brand.description: The version brand.json is written at, before any upgrade in memory, or null with no brand.json.

packages.description: The packages the site installs, or null for a site not on `install` yet.

apps.description: Each installed app, or null for a site not on `install` yet.

status.description: stable, beta or draft today. A newer engine may add one.
